fusions.name: Drag of the Current
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 8 damage, loses 8% armour for 6 seconds, is slowed by 30% and is pushed back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Unhurried Blow
fusions.desc: A heavy strike that costs 4% of your maximum health, deals 8 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifting Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Following the Current

riders.text: you close distance faster over water

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank, you move 15% faster over it.
